about_the_game:
About This Game

The outbreak has begun. After a technology company’s experiment went wrong, the population has been turned into ravenous, flesh-eating monsters. Trapped in the ruins of the city, you must fight to survive. Scavenge supplies, battle hordes of infected, and face terrifying bosses as you search for answers.

Death Hive is a top-down zombie survival shooter combining fast-paced combat, resource management, and exploration. Gather ammo and health packs, use fires to keep warm in the frigid environment, and push deeper into the infested streets.

Features

  • Twin-stick shooting – precise top-down combat against relentless hordes.

  • Scavenge to survive – defeat zombies to find ammo, health, and supplies.

  • Environmental survival – endure the cold by staying near fires.

  • Engaging boss fights – face unique, challenging enemies with different attack styles.

  • Exploration & discovery – uncover survivors, supplies, and the truth behind the outbreak.

Demo Content

  • Playable section of the city to explore.

  • Several weapons and upgrades available.

  • A preview boss encounter to test your skills.

  • Around 30–60 minutes of gameplay, depending on play style.

content_descriptors.notes: It is a top-down zombie shooter, with blood effects.
